ReleaseNotes: Added support for editing legacy/imported Site History entries while preserving the original imported source data.
Fixed Ticket Status renames so existing tickets automatically update to the new status name.
Fixed the Dispatch Tickets “All / Include Closed” status filter so it truly includes tickets with any status, including legacy or inactive statuses.
Added a copy-to-clipboard button beside Site numbers in Field Technician History, with the same temporary checkmark feedback used for Notifications and Work Orders.
